Signature.Documentation: This test case tests a CB-AdES-B-B signature built on an untagged COSE_Sign structure with attached payload and two signers (two COSE_Signature elements). The body-layer protected header shall not be present and the body-layer unprotected header shall not be present (uHeaders shall not be present in the body layer, clause 4.4). Each COSE_Signature (signer layer) shall contain only the minimum mandatory components: the protected header parameters alg, CWT Claims (enclosing iat) and x5chain. Each signer shall use its own signing certificate. The x5chain header parameter shall be a protected header parameter. At least the signing certificate shall be included in x5chain; the certificates needed for building the certification path should also be included.
